subject: integration
name: Load from the site's server over HTTPS
summary: Loads a site's files from the web server a name's record names, over HTTPS. With a DDOC record each file is checked against its hash tree; without one the server's word is all there is: nothing checks the pages and scripts it sends, which then run in the browser. HTTPS protects the link, not the content. It relies on that one server, which sees each visit and can withhold files. Level 1, not higher: part of what runs comes from outside what Orivon pinned. On by default. Judged here by its publisher.
